explanation: Faithfully encodes erdosproblems.com/267: for every strictly increasing n_k with n_{k+1}/n_k ≥ c > 1, Σ 1/F_{n_k} is irrational. The ratio is computed in ℚ, so a junk n₀ = 0 makes the hypothesis fail rather than trivialising the statement. My cached copy of the page says this is proved only for c ≥ 2 (Badea) and open for 1 < c < 2. The `research solved` tag therefore rests entirely on the linked formal proof (williamjblair 'starfleet'), and a citation would help.
